errors.generic: The request could not be processed. Try again shortly.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed it first. The latest state was reloaded.
errors.precondition: This request needs a concurrency header. Reload the latest state and try again.
errors.inProgress: The same operation is already in progress. Check its state instead of creating a new one.
errors.emergencyStop: Submission is blocked while emergency stop is active.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.

errors.agentGrantForbidden: Agents cannot be granted approval permission. Their send access is limited to human-approved messages.

smtp.title: SMTP delivery
smtp.description: Configure a campaign sender. Office owns campaign content and adds its compliance footer; SMTP provides the reviewed delivery route.
smtp.checkNotice: The connection check validates SMTP authentication and TLS with a NOOP. It does not send email or confirm that the From alias can deliver or that a recipient received a message.
smtp.mailAccountsRequired: Connect a mail account before adding SMTP settings.
smtp.loadFailed: Could not load SMTP connections. Try again.
smtp.empty: No SMTP connections have been configured.
smtp.lastCheckFailed: The last connection check failed. Review the settings and try again.
smtp.requestFailed: The request failed. Review the SMTP settings and try again.
smtp.passwordHint: Use an app password created under Zoho account (accounts.zoho.com) → Security → App Passwords, not your Zoho sign-in password.
smtp.fromAliasHint: Enter a Zoho alias to send from it; leave blank to send from the selected mailbox address. SMTP login still uses the mailbox address.
smtp.replyToHint: Replies go to this address. Leave blank to receive them at the From address.
smtp.replyToAliasHint: Because you send from an alias, replies go to {address} when left blank. Enter another address to override.
smtp.advancedHint: smtppro.zoho.com · 587 · STARTTLS. Login and From address default to the selected mailbox. Change only for another Zoho data center (.eu, .in…) or an alias.
smtp.formDescription: The password is write-only and encrypted on the server. It is cleared when this form closes.
smtp.senderConfirmationRequired: Confirm that this From address is registered to the selected mail account.
smtp.customHeadersInvalid: Custom headers must be valid JSON with only the allowed header names and single-line string values.
smtp.name: Connection name
smtp.customHeadersHint: Allowed: X-Auto-Response-Suppress and X-Importance. Office adds campaign correlation and recipient-specific unsubscribe headers itself.
smtp.senderConfirmed: This From address is registered to the selected mail account.
smtp.disableDescription: {name} will stop being available for campaign delivery.

campaignSender.title: Default sender for sales campaigns
campaignSender.description: New sales campaigns use this active marketing profile. Existing campaigns keep their bound sender.
campaignSender.unset: No ready default marketing sender is set. Choose an active marketing profile below.
campaignSender.unready: The default sender {name} is not ready. Choose another active marketing profile below.
campaignSender.loadFailed: The default sender could not be loaded.
campaignSender.saveFailed: The default sender could not be changed. Refresh and try again.

inbox.title: SMTP inbox sync
inbox.credentialNotice: Inbox sync reuses the encrypted SMTP credential stored for this connection. No separate IMAP password is shown or requested.
inbox.loadFailed: Could not load inbox sync status.
inbox.bookmarkDescription: This internal IMAP bookmark records where incremental sync should resume.
inbox.syncQueued: Manual inbox sync request is queued.
inbox.requestFailed: Could not update inbox sync settings. Try again.

members.title: Members
members.description: Manage members, roles, agent principals, and invitations.
members.disableDescription: Disabling is accepted as a job (202) together with a reassignment / pending-work policy.
members.emptyDescription: Add members with an admin-issued invite link.
members.inviteCreatedDescription: This link is shown only once. It cannot be viewed again after you share it.
members.inviteMissingLink: The response contained no invite link. Check the invitation list for status.

invitation.emptyDescription: Invitation status appears here once a link is created.

agents.emptyDescription: Create an agent principal and issue service credentials.

credentials.clientConfigHint: Paste into the config of an HTTP MCP client such as Claude Code or Cursor. This token cannot be shown again.
credentials.createdDescription: This secret is shown only once. Store it somewhere safe.
credentials.revokeDescription: Auth is rejected immediately, and pending work requested by this credential is stopped (default).

mailAccounts.title: Mail accounts
mailAccounts.description: Shared mailbox connections and per-mailbox grants.
mailAccounts.oauthNotice: OAuth tokens are encrypted on the server and never displayed here.
mailAccounts.connectDescription: Connect Zoho Mail to share an inbox and manage correspondence. Marketing campaigns send through configured Office SMTP connections.
mailAccounts.oauthClientDescription: Enter the Server-based Application values issued in the Zoho API Console. The client secret is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
mailAccounts.clientSecretPlaceholder: Client secret from the Zoho API Console
mailAccounts.clientSecretKeep: Stored value kept (enter a new value to replace it)
mailAccounts.redirectUriHint: Register this exact value under Authorized Redirect URIs in the Zoho API Console.
mailAccounts.oauthConfigured: Using the saved Zoho OAuth client.
mailAccounts.oauthConfiguredEnv: Using the Zoho OAuth client from server environment variables.
mailAccounts.oauthChangeNotice: Changing the client may require reconnecting mailboxes that are already connected.
mailAccounts.oauthLoadError: Could not load the Zoho OAuth settings
mailAccounts.regionHint: Live Zoho Mail connections currently support US (com) data-center accounts only.
mailAccounts.oauthRedirectPath: The Redirect URI must end with /api/v1/integrations/zoho/callback (the old zoho-campaigns path does not work)
mailAccounts.reconnectDone: Reauth started. Check the connection status.
mailAccounts.emptyDescription: Connect a mailbox to grant read, compose, send, approve, and assign permissions.

grants.title: Mailbox grants
grants.rulesNotice: Grants apply as an intersection with role permissions. A child permission cannot be on without its parent.
grants.blockRole: Approve can only be granted to Admin or Manager

calendars.privacyNotice: Private event details are never shown. Only connection metadata is visible.
calendars.officeDescription: Office stores booking reservations in this workspace and blocks overlapping reservations.
calendars.officeSyncNotice: Bookings are not synchronized to an external calendar.
calendars.officeSetupSuccess: Office internal calendar is ready for meeting types.
calendars.zohoDescription: Connect a Zoho calendar through OAuth to check availability against an external calendar.
calendars.emptyDescription: Set up the Office internal calendar or connect Zoho to offer public booking slots.
